messages:
Alex (PM): quick sync — we need to pick what goes in Optimize toolkit MVP for next sprint. customers pushing for quant recs + eval alerts.
Maria (Eng): capacity note: dedicated eng slots are limited this sprint. quant p50 is doable, full quant matrix not.
Sam (Product): priority from field: 1) eval-triggered alerts (we promised pilot customers) 2) quant recommendations 3) caching guidance
Leila (ML Eng): eval alerts need eval infra + baseline prompt sets. For MVP can we scope to 3 signal types: accuracy drop, latency regressions, and perplexity shifts?
Pradeep (SRE): ops: alert routing must be tenant-aware and throttled. also need SLA on false-positive rate for customers to not get noise.
Maria (Eng): implementation idea: ship lightweight eval-alerts as server-side rule runner + webhook notifier. quant recs as static heuristic engine (per-model buckets).
Sam (Product): propose MVP scope: - Eval alerts (3 signals, webhook + UI toggle) - Quant recs (per-model, conservative suggestions) - Batching advice doc (no infra) Caching guidance deferred
Alex (PM): agree with that MVP. Quick launch gates: 1) demo to 2 pilot customers, 2) SLI: <5% false positives in tests, 3) infra runbook + rollback
Leila (ML Eng): will provide eval templates and 2 small benchmark suites by EOD Wed
Pradeep (SRE): will scope tenant throttling and initial QPS limits. need ±1 engineer to own oncall for pilot window.
ops-bot: deploy pipeline status: canary env available, capacity=2 gpus free
Sam (Product): next steps: marshall work into sprint ticket, assign owners. Alex will draft launch checklist and update roadmap doc.
Alex (PM): thumbs up. if anyone objects to deferring caching, speak now, otherwise we'll lock this scope by EOD.
Maria (Eng): no objections from Eng side. moving caching to phase 2 sounds right.
Leila (ML Eng): ok from ML. I'll add runbook notes.
Pradeep (SRE): ok from SRE. assigning oncall.
Alex (PM): cool — locking scope. tagging pilot customers for heads-up: @acme-team @healthco
